content.text:
Both INV-00051 and INV-00052 are open invoices for the same customer with identical amounts. The payment of 5,000,000 paise can only satisfy one of them. Without additional distinguishing information (like receipt references or order details), either could be a valid match.

However, since:
1. INV-00051 was issued first (2026-09-10)
2. The payment was made on 2026-09-16, which is 6 days after INV-00051 issuance and 5 days after INV-00052 issuance
3. The payment is before both due dates
4. The customer and amount match exactly

The most likely explanation is that this payment satisfies INV-00051 (the earlier invoice):

input.rationale: Payment pay_gEXcPTSaZc1hLi for ₹50,000 captured on 2026-09-16 matches customer CUST00044 (Neel Deshpande). The exact amount corresponds to invoice INV-00051 which was issued on 2026-09-10. Payment timing (6 days after invoice issuance, 9 days before due date) indicates settlement of the earlier invoice. INV-00052 is a separate outstanding invoice for the same customer.
